sessions.caught: Issues with my lease such as a flood risk, management out of state address, and overcharging on late fees.
sessions.quote: The app surfaced information about my address that I hadn’t found on my own, and made it easy to understand what was available in one place. The experience felt clear, useful, and surprisingly insightful. I especially appreciated how straightforward it was to explore the results. Overall, this is a thoughtful, polished app that makes finding relevant information feel effortless.
sessions.correction: Participant reported the by-hand timer under-recorded; actual time by hand was about 11 minutes.
